We are Park Lawn

Where Adults With Disabilities Thrive

Programs
Donate

Dignity and Pride Delivered Daily

Everyone deserves an opportunity to contribute, connect and be valued. Since 1955, Park Lawn has been helping people with intellectual and developmental disabilities thrive.​

​Today, as a nationally accredited not-for-profit organization, Park Lawn stands stronger than ever. We have branched out into the community with beautifully renovated facilities that are uniquely suited to the diverse needs and positive energy of our participants. Every day we open our doors to limitless possibilities, and we invite you to join us.
